CAD stroke robustness

Four analytic mechanical profiles with known dimensions, plus four image-generated engineering sketches. 40 cases; 19 meet all defined checks. Most cases deliberately simulate poor drawing. These are development stress tests, not human-user accuracy.

Teal: fitted geometry. Grey: source ink. Blue dashed: known CAD truth. A REVIEW may still look close while losing a hole, rounded corner, closure or intended component.

Known inference spend across 108 attempts: $0.18223; 20 attempts have unknown usage. Generation, audio, CAD agent and hosting are excluded. Current rows may replay saved model decisions through a corrected numerical decoder; they are not fresh accuracy samples. Earlier frozen results and failed attempts remain in the JSON.

Checks: outline/hole counts and containment; circular feature types; 6% per-feature contour deviation; 5% circle diameter and hole-center tolerance; local fillet/slot-arc error at most 20% of its radius; editable native argument validity. A missing-hole case expects only the holes actually drawn. Geometric checks do not establish 3D solidity or a native fillet feature.
